title: Column: Tin breaks higher as Indonesia cracks down on illegal miners
body: The tin market is once again bubbling on supply chain trouble, this time in Indonesia.

title: Indonesia’s Merdeka starts mining at Pani gold project
body: The company aims to produce 140,000 ounces of gold annually.

title: Freeport to divest 12% of mine to Indonesia, CNBC says
body: The divestment is part of an agreement to extend the company’s license to operate the Grasberg mine.

title: Indonesia halts Grasberg operations to search for trapped workers
body: Two workers have died and five remain missing following a large mudflow earlier this month.

title: Central Omega Resources Reports Record Production and Profit Surge in H1 2025
body: In the first half of 2025, Central Omega Resources ramped up nickel ore production to 1.73 Mt—up 140%—and sales to 1.83 Mt, driving net profit to Rp310.3 bn (38% rise) and EBITDA to Rp481.4 bn (219% jump) as full mining operations resumed under a new 2024 RKAB. The company remains optimistic through 2025 amid stable global nickel prices but remains cautious of US tariff uncertainties, pledging to boost operational efficiency, explore new reserves, and adopt sustainable resource management.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Prices Rise in Early October 2025, APNI Highlights Need for Market‑Reflective Adjustments
body: In the first half of October 2025, nickel prices climbed to US$15.101.67 per dmt, up from US$15.000.33 in the second half of September, as reported by APNI, which also set benchmark prices for various nickel grades and moisture contents—US$28.75 per wmt for 1.60% grade with 30% MC, US$40.17 for 1.90% grade, and US$37.30 for 1.90% grade with 35% MC—while urging the government to adjust prices to better reflect market realities, especially for low‑grade domestic miners.

title: Merdeka Battery Materials Reports 78% Rise in Nickel Ore Production Amid Revenue Decline, Focus on HPAL Expansion
body: PT Merdeka Battery Materials Tbk. reported a 78% YoY increase in nickel ore output to 6.9 Mt wmt in H1 2025, driven by 45% growth in limonite and 189% in saprolite, while revenue fell 32% to US$628 M. The company also cut NPI cash costs below US$10 k/ton, sold 9,465 t of MHP via ESG’s Train A, and is advancing HPAL projects and new feed preparation plants with completion targets by mid‑2026.

title: APNI Releases Indonesia Nickel Price Index: Stable Nickel Prices, MHP Decline Signals Battery Demand Shift
body: APNI's latest Indonesia Nickel Price Index shows most nickel products remain stable, with nickel ore 1.2% and 1.6% priced at US$23/mt and US$52.15/mt respectively, while nickel pig iron and high‑grade matte stay flat. However, mixed hydroxide precipitate (MHP) fell by US$7/mt to US$13,145/mt, hinting at a potential softening in global battery raw‑material demand amid Indonesia’s EV industry expansion.
